players.product: Semiconductor-related adhesive tapes and semiconductor-related devices

quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (April - September 2025): net sales JPY 154,752 million (down 2.4%) as, although semiconductor and electronic component-related products remained firm, the closure of the Korean and Taiwanese subsidiaries and exchange rates weighed; operating income JPY 12,767 million (down 6.7%) on higher raw material and fuel prices, higher fixed costs including personnel costs and exchange rates; ordinary income JPY 12,487 million (down 12.5%); net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 8,928 million (down 17.4%).
quarterly_data.figure: net sales JPY 154,752 million (-2.4%); operating income JPY 12,767 million (-6.7%); net income JPY 8,928 million (-17.4%)

quarterly_data.signal: Electronic and Optical Products segment, H1 FY2026: net sales JPY 46,946 million (down 2.5%) as the closure of the Korean and Taiwanese subsidiaries offset strong semiconductor and electronic component-related products; operating income JPY 10,456 million (up 10.2%). Advanced Materials Operations net sales JPY 42,675 million (up 2.4%): semiconductor-related adhesive tapes were firm on increased generative-AI-related demand, but semiconductor-related devices decreased as orders for HBM manufacturing ran their course; Optical Materials Operations JPY 4,271 million (down 34.2%).
quarterly_data.figure: segment net sales JPY 46,946 million (-2.5%); operating income JPY 10,456 million (+10.2%); Advanced Materials Operations JPY 42,675 million (+2.4%)

quarterly_data.signal: Other segments, H1 FY2026: Printing and Industrial Materials Products net sales JPY 89,865 million (down 2.8%), operating income JPY 1,673 million (down 53.0%) on lower US sales and higher fixed costs in Japan and the US; Paper and Converted Products net sales JPY 17,940 million (up 0.3%), operating income JPY 592 million (down 3.7%). H1 R&D expenses JPY 5,721 million.
quarterly_data.figure: Printing and Industrial Materials JPY 89,865 million (-2.8%); Paper and Converted JPY 17,940 million (+0.3%); R&D JPY 5,721 million
